summary.text: Zack Maynard is a Republican state senator from West Virginia who was appointed to District 7 in October 2025 and is seeking election to a full term on November 3, 2026.
He previously served in the House of Delegates from 2016 to 2022.

paragraphs.text: Zack Maynard represented House of Delegates District 22 from 2016 to 2022.
Governor Patrick Morrisey appointed him to the State Senate on October 30, 2025, to replace Mike Stuart, and he took office on November 5, 2025.
He advanced from the Republican primary on May 12, 2026.
